verses.web: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
verses.kjv: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.web: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.web: I thank my God whenever I remember you,
verses.kjv: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

verses.web: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all making my requests with joy,
verses.kjv: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

verses.web: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
verses.kjv: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

verses.web: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

verses.web: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.
verses.kjv: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.

verses.web: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.

verses.web: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;
verses.kjv: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

verses.web: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;
verses.kjv: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

verses.web: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
verses.kjv: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.

verses.web: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;
verses.kjv: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

verses.web: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;
verses.kjv: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

verses.web: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.
verses.kjv: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

verses.web: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.
verses.kjv: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

verses.web: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
verses.kjv: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

verses.web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
verses.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

verses.web: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
verses.kjv: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

verses.web: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.kjv: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

verses.web: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.
verses.kjv: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

verses.web: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.kjv: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

verses.web: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.
verses.kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

verses.web: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
verses.kjv: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:

verses.web: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

verses.web: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,
verses.kjv: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

verses.web: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.
verses.kjv: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

verses.web: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;
verses.kjv: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

verses.web: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.
verses.kjv: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.

verses.web: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
verses.kjv: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

verses.web: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.
verses.kjv: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

verses.web: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
verses.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

verses.web: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
verses.kjv: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

verses.web: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
verses.kjv: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

verses.web: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
verses.kjv: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

verses.web: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
verses.kjv: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

verses.web: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
verses.kjv: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

verses.web: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
verses.kjv: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

verses.web: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.
verses.kjv: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

verses.web: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;
verses.kjv: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

verses.web: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
verses.kjv: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

verses.web: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.kjv: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

verses.web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

verses.web: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
verses.kjv: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

verses.web: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,
verses.kjv: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

verses.web: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
verses.kjv: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

verses.web: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
verses.kjv: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

verses.web: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.
verses.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

verses.web: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.
verses.kjv: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

verses.web: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
verses.kjv: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

verses.web: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
verses.kjv: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

verses.web: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
verses.kjv: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

verses.web: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
verses.kjv: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

verses.web: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
verses.kjv: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

verses.web: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
verses.kjv: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

verses.web: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;
verses.kjv: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

verses.web: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.
verses.kjv: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

verses.web: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
verses.kjv: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

verses.web: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.kjv: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

verses.web: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,
verses.kjv: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

verses.web: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
verses.kjv: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

verses.web: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
verses.kjv: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

verses.web: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.
verses.kjv: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

verses.web: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
verses.kjv: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

verses.web: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:
verses.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

verses.web: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
verses.kjv: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

verses.web: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
verses.kjv: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

verses.web: However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.
verses.kjv: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

verses.web: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ
verses.kjv: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,

verses.web: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;
verses.kjv: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:

verses.web: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;
verses.kjv: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

verses.web: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
verses.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

verses.web: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, if it is so that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

verses.web: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,
verses.kjv: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

verses.web: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.web: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.
verses.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

verses.web: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

verses.web: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
verses.kjv: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.

verses.web: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,
verses.kjv: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:

verses.web: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
verses.kjv: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

verses.web: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;
verses.kjv: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:

verses.web: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
verses.kjv: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

verses.web: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.
verses.kjv: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

verses.web: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.
verses.kjv: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.web: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.kjv: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

verses.web: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
verses.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

verses.web: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

verses.web: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
verses.kjv: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

verses.web: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

verses.web: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.
verses.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

verses.web: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.
verses.kjv: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.

verses.web: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
verses.kjv: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.

verses.web: Not that I speak in respect to lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
verses.kjv: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

verses.web: I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
verses.kjv: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

verses.web: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
verses.kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

verses.web: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.
verses.kjv: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.

verses.web: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.
verses.kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

verses.web: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.
verses.kjv: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.

verses.web: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
verses.kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

verses.web: But I have all things, and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.
verses.kjv: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.

verses.web: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
verses.kjv: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

verses.web: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.
verses.kjv: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.web: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
verses.kjv: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.

verses.web: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.
verses.kjv: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Cesar’s household.

verses.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
